title: Graph-Guided Selective Unlearning for Language Models: Controlling Support Routes Beyond Forget Seeds
abstract: arXiv:2608.26743v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Enterprises fine-tune language models on proprietary data that may later require removal due to privacy, contractual, or compliance obligations. Selective unlearning removes requested knowledge while preserving model utility, offering a practical alternative to full retraining, but existing methods treat the explicitly identified forget examples as the complete deletion scope. This is insufficient when target knowledge remains recoverable through paraphrases, aliases, or neighboring training examples. We propose GRAPHSU, a graph-guided controller that expands the deletion scope beyond forget seeds by constructing a weighted support-route graph, propagating deletion pressure through it, and applying graded forgetting strengths to high-risk neighbors. On the Task of Fictitious Unlearning (TOFU), a synthetic author-profile question-answering benchmark, and PISTOL, a structural-unlearning benchmark built around interconnected factual samples

translated_title: 图引导的语言模型选择性遗忘：超越遗忘种子的支持路径控制
translated_abstract: 摘要：企业会在专有数据上对语言模型进行微调，但随后可能因隐私、合同或合规要求而需要移除这些数据。选择性遗忘旨在移除所请求的知识，同时保留模型效用，为完全重新训练提供了一种实用的替代方案，但现有方法仅将明确标识的遗忘示例视为完整的删除范围。当目标知识仍可通过改写、别名或邻近训练示例恢复时，这种方法是不够的。我们提出了GRAPHSU，一种图引导的控制器，通过构建加权支持路径图、沿图传播删除压力，并对高风险邻居应用分级遗忘强度，从而将删除范围扩展到遗忘种子之外。在虚构遗忘任务（TOFU）——一个合成作者档案问答基准，以及PISTOL——一个围绕相互关联的事实样本构建的结构性遗忘基准上，我们验证了该方法的有效性。
tldr: 本文提出GRAPHSU，一种基于加权支持路径图的图引导控制器，通过传播删除压力并应用分级遗忘强度，扩展选择性遗忘的删除范围，从而有效防止目标知识通过改写或邻近样本被恢复。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes GRAPHSU, a graph-guided controller that expands the deletion scope in selective unlearning by constructing a weighted support-route graph, propagating deletion pressure, and applying graded forgetting strengths to prevent target knowledge recovery via paraphrases or neighboring samples.
